crossRefs.note: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.
crossRefs.keyword: in times past. Heb. both yesterday and the third day

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.
translations.bsb: Now Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, “In the past you sought David as your king.
translations.kjv: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:
translations.asv: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, In times past ye sought for David to be king over you:
